descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# ArdiSportsVR
Immerses you in a unique and immersive experience with a range of sports arcade games. Your goal is to get the highest score by competing with your friends or your own score. Test your athletic skills in a virtual reality environment. Do you have what it takes to be crowned the ArdiSportsVR champion? Find out now!

# List of games:
1. **ARDI🏀BASKET**
